verdict.rationale: Treasury has a documented API covering its core objects and money movement: FinancialAccounts, funding, OutboundPayments, ReceivedDebits, Transaction ledger entries and transaction events. Programmatic control of the main workflows is clearly first-party. However, the docs present Dashboard and mobile-app access for a business's own financial account and prebuilt embedded UI components, and nothing states that every UI action has an API equivalent. Parity is implied, not documented. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that Dashboard-only Treasury features (e.g., non-platform financial account management) are API-accessible, and independent corroboration of full parity.
